proof.source: Physical source records bind the ordered group-1005 references to a model-space MESH and a named-block 3DLINE with distinct owners and exact entity types. Typed import confirms the mesh version/flags, ordered vertices and face indices, plus the 3DLINE endpoints, thickness and extrusion.

limits: This qualifies one ordered AC1027 code-1005 pair with a model-space MESH followed by a named-BLOCKS 3DLINE, for the selected ASCII/binary input/output combinations. Other pair orderings, target combinations, source/output sections, versions, code-1005 counts and XDATA profiles remain open.
